title: Substack Direct Subscribe
description: A lightweight React package for collecting Substack email subscriptions directly from a site, without a server, proxy, or backend.
content:
This started as a practical fix for Substack forms on static and server-rendered sites. Standard server-side requests can fail on cloud hosting, so the package sends the subscription request from the visitor's browser instead.

I wrapped that approach into two small React components: SubstackForm for inline forms and SubstackPopup for timed prompts. Both include idle, submitting, success, and error states, with minimal styling assumptions.

The goal was to keep the integration boring in the best way. Add the component, pass in the Substack publication details, and let the user's browser handle the request. No backend route, no proxy service, no stored email data.
